data.name: Query_DispatchDetailReportForFind
data.value:
SELECT Distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AS DeliveryOrderHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AS DeliveryOrderDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DispatchItemID,dispatchItem.Description as DispatchItem, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS BaseQuantity, SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, SAL_OrderDetail.BaseAmount, (SAL_OrderDetail.Rate * SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) AS NetAmount, (SAL_OrderDetail.Rate * SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) AS Amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, isnull(inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode,'')+''+ INV_Item.Description as Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit, Set_Batch.Description as Batch, Sum(ISNULL(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, IsNull(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0)) * (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)), 0)) AS TotalAmount, '' [Action], SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID as DODocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, set_location.LocationName, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID], set_rack.RackName, IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive, 0) As IsInclusive,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks, 0 as RemainingQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoOfPackages ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID When 1 then 'Medium' When 2 then 'Bold' When 3 then 'Fine' else '' end AS GrainSizeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID When 1 then 'With_InnerLiner' When 2 then 'Without_InnerLiner' else '' end AS PackingName FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --and Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] left JOIN [INV_Item] dispatchItem ON dispatchItem.[ItemID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 left join set_location on set_location.LocationID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[LocationID] left join set_rack on set_rack.rackID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID] inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID] = @DispatchID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 Group By SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID, inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, Set_Batch.Description, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity, SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, SAL_OrderDetail.BaseAmount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, set_location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, set_rack.RackName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoOfPackages ,GrainSizeID,PackTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.DispatchItemID,dispatchItem.Description ORDER BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID]

data.name: Query_DispatchDetailReportNew
data.value: select Convert(int, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) As DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As TotalAmount, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Dispatch_TransactionQuantity, Case When IsNull(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive, 0) = 0 Then ((Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / 100 Else ((Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) End as SAL_FEDAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount as SalGrosssAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount as SalNetAmount, isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) as SAL_FedRate ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus ,SAL_OrderHeader.TotalAmount as GrandTotal from SAL_DispatchHeader inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.status = 1 where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}

data.name: Query_FAWDispatchOrderReport
data.value:
SELECT Distinct isnull(( select top 1 isnull(SAL_ReverseHeader.Status,0) as IsCancelDispatch from SAL_ReverseHeader
inner join inv_StockTransactionheader on inv_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and inv_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and inv_StockTransactionheader.periodID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.periodID inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = inv_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.periodID = inv_StockTransactionDetail.periodID ),0)as IsCancelDispatch, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName],SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1, [AR_SET_Customer].[AddressLine1] AS CustomerAddress, Transporters.CustomerName as Transporter, Transporters.AddressLine1 AS TransporterAddress, [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentType] AS DispatchType, [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], '---' AS PSONo, [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName as VehicleCategory, [SET_Location].[LocationName] AS Location, [SET_VehicleType].[TypeName] AS VehicleType, --[SET_ItemCatalog].[Description] AS Catalog, [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyNo, [SAL_DispatchHeader].RefrenceNo as Chassis, [SAL_DispatchHeader].VehicleNo, [INV_Item].Description as Vehicle, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments as Engine, [SAL_DispatchHeader].[GatePassNo] , '--' as ColorName, [SET_ItemCatalog].Description as Catalog, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ARS ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = ARS.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = ARS.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = ARS.[CustomerID] Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[PeriodID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[CompanyID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporters ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporters.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporters.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporters.[CustomerID] left Join AR_Set_Customer ARST ON ARST.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID AND ARST.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND ARST.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN [SET_City] ON [SET_City].[CityID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] AND [SET_City].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] INNER JOIN [SET_VehicleType] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] = [SET_VehicleType].[VehicleTypeID] INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID and[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID = [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID And [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID = [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId LEFT JOIN [SET_ItemCatalog] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SET_ItemCatalog].[ItemCatalogID] WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] =@CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_GetDateWiseLiftingReport
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,case SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DeliveryOrderStatus ,[SET_Batch].[Description] as Batch ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchID] ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DispatchStatus ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CompanyID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[PeriodID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DocumentTypeID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[GatePassNo] As DCNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[VehicleNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[BiltyNo] --,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.[Quantity] ,(case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = 178 then (SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] * -1) else SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] end) as TotalAmount ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[GrossWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TareWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[NetWeight] ,[INV_Item].[Description] --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1, 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure Else IsNull(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure end as Quantity
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity * -1 Else abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) end as Bags FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
inner join [SET_Batch] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[Season] = [SET_Batch].[BatchID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_Batch].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_Batch].[PeriodID] AND [SET_Batch].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER join set_documenttype on set_documenttype.DocumentTypeID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID AND set_documenttype.CompanyID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_GetDispatchOrderDetail_CustomerWiseReport
data.value:
SELECT SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, (Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) Quantity, CAST((datepart(year,SET_BATCH.FromDate))AS VARCHAR(10))+'-'+CAST((datepart(year,SET_BATCH.ToDate))AS VARCHAR(10))as Batch, SAL_OrderDetail.Rate AS UnitPrice , SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount As TaxRate, ASCT.CustomerName, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName , SET_Currency.CurrencySign , SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount , SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, SAL_OrderHeader.Season, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_OrderHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus
FROM SAL_OrderDetail INNER JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN Inv_StockTransactionDetail ON Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_OrderHeader.SaleContractTypeID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID INNER JOIN SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SET_OperatingUnit.BaseCurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_OrderHeader.PaymentTermID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCT ON ASCT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And ASCT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And ASCT.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = ASCT.CityID LEFT JOIN SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID LEFT JOIN SET_BATCH ON CAST(SET_BATCH.BATCHID as Varchar(10)) = SAL_ORDERHEADER.SEASON --AND SET_BATCH.COMPANYID = SAL_ORDERHEADER.COMPANYID AND SET_BATCH.PeriodID = SAL_ORDERHEADER.PeriodID

data.name: Query_GetSalesOrderFromDispatch
data.value:
Select Distinct SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo ,Sal_OrderDetail.Inclusive ,Sal_OrderDetail.IsSalesTaxExempted ,Sal_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount ,Sal_OrderDetail.IsExciseDutyExempted ,Sal_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyamount ,Sal_OrderDetail.IsFEDExempted ,Sal_OrderDetail.FEDAmount
From Sal_Dispatchheader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_OrderDetail ON Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND Sal_OrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner JOIN Sal_OrderHeader ON Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID AND Sal_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Where Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.Status = 1 AND Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNO = @DispatchNo

data.name: Query_Get_DispatchVehicle
data.value:
Select distinct Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo, Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate,Sal_DispatchVehicleInformation.BiltyNo as Bilty, SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Chassis, SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Engine, Set_Color.ColorName, INV_Item.description As Vehicle, case when SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID is not null then 'Return' else '' end As [Version], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno As PSONo, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName As DealerName, Set_City.CityName, ARS.CustomerName As Customer, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo AS DONo, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate, '??' As P_S_ONo, ARST.CustomerName As Transporter, Sal_Dispatchheader.BiltyNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments As Remarks
FROM [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation] INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[DispatchID] INNER JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[VehicleInformationID] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporters ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporters.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporters.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporters.[CustomerID] INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DOVehicleInformation.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID And SAL_DOVehicleInformation.DODetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID INNER JOIN data.name: Query_GoodsIssuesWithSalesTax
data.value:
select
'('+ cast( AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID as varchar(40)) +') - ' + AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Customer ,Sal_OrderHeader.ContractNo ,cast( Sal_OrderHeader.ContractDate as date ) as ContractDate ,Sal_OrderHeadeR.PaidAmount ,SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity as Sal_OrderQuantity ,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as SAL_Rate ,ROUND( SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ,0) as Amount ,Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo , CAST (Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate AS DATE) AS DODate ,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity as Del_Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,cast ( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as date ) as DispatchDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount Dis_Amount ,abs( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ) as DispatchQuantity , isnull ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced,0 ) as QuantityInvoiced ,isnull( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount ,0) as INV_GrossAmount ,isnull( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].NetAmount ,0) as INV_NetAmount ,isnull ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount, 0) as TaxAmount ,isnull ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDAmount ,0) as FEDAmount ,convert ( varchar(15), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,110) InvoiceDate ,ISNULL( SAL_Invoicedetail.UnitPrice ,0 ) as INV_Rate ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber from
Sal_Dispatchheader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT join [SAL_InvoiceHeader] on [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].Status =1 Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_OrderDetail ON Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND Sal_OrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner JOIN Sal_OrderHeader ON Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID AND Sal_OrderHeader.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_OrderHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID= Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Where Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_INvoiceDispatch
data.value:
SELECT [InvoiceDetailID] ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[SerialNumber],SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as DocumentNo ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID], [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName as Category,[INV_Item].Description as Item, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,[SAL_DOVehicleInformation].Chassis,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as Date,'Invoice' as Status
FROM [SAL_InvoiceDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
Inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_Invoiceheader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_Invoiceheader.periodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.periodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[VehicleID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].StockHeaderID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} --AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID] = @CategoryID --AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID = 29
union all
SELECT Distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID,1 as SerialNumber,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as DocumentNo, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName as Category, INV_Item.Description as Item,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.Chassis,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date ,'Dispatch' as Status FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation on SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} --AND SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID = @CategoryID

,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[TransporterID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleNo] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DriverContactNumber],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LoadingSupervisorName],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[QualitySupervisorID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LoadingSupervisorID], (Select SUM(TAB.QTY) from (select isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0) * -1 as QTY from Inv_StockTransactionHeader STH Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail STD On STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID And STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID And STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID Where STH.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And STH.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And STH.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo And STH.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID ) as TAB )as LiftedQty ,abs(sum(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as Quantity ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as DocumentDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as DocumentNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID Inner Join Sal_OrderDetail On Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID Inner Join Sal_OrderHeader On Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID

data.name: Query_SelectAll_WithPaging_ForApprove
data.value:
Select *, ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by Cast(Dispatch.DispatchNo as int) desc) as 'Row' From ( SELECT distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Customer, SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID, SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID, SAL_DispatchHeader.Status, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID AS UserID, --SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, (Select SUM(TAB.QTY) from (select isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0) * -1 as QTY from Inv_StockTransactionHeader STH Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail STD On STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID And STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID And STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID Where STH.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And STH.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And STH.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo And STH.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID ) as TAB )as LiftedQty, abs(sum(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as DocumentDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo As DocumentNo ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo)
inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID Left Join Sal_OrderDetail On Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID Left Join Sal_OrderHeader On Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID
INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID =@CurrentFiscalID {filter}
group by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID, SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID, SAL_DispatchHeader.[Status], SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName ) as Dispatch
