data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], --max(SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno) as referenceno, '' as referenceno, --Discussed with Azhar Bhai Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) as StockQuantity, (select abs(Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1)) as qty from [INV_StockTransactionDetail] where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 )as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) * -1) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty ,( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID )as ReverseQty
FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled] <> 1 and isnull([SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComplet,0) <> 1 {0}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) )tab Where (tab.TransactionQty - isnull(ReverseQty,0)) > InvoicedQuantity Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_Select_By_CustomerIDDispatch
data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], '' as referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) * -1) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty
FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 {0}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) )tab Where tab.TransactionQty > InvoicedQuantity {1} Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_Select_By_CustomerIDForDO
data.value:
Select [StockTransactionID],[DispatchNo] From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) * -1) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty
FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] = @DOID OR @DOID IS NULL) AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 {0}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) )tab Where tab.TransactionQty > InvoicedQuantity Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_Select_By_CustomerID_ForLubricantReturn
data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, --'' as referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) * -1) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty ,isnull([INV_StockTransactionDetail].ReversedQuantity,0) as ReversedQuantity FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 {0}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ReversedQuantity --HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) )tab --Where tab.TransactionQty > InvoicedQuantity Where tab.TransactionQty > tab.ReversedQuantity Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_Select_WholeMonth_By_StockID
data.value: Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.StockTransactionID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, 0)) as InvoicedQuantity, Cast(( ( select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ) * -1) AS Decimal(18, 0)) TransactionQty FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN ( Select CompanyID, PeriodID, BusinessPartnerID, DocumentDate From Inv_StockTransactionHeader Where CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockTransactionID = @StockHeaderID ) AS SelectedDispatch ON SelectedDispatch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND SelectedDispatch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND SelectedDispatch.BusinessPartnerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND MONTH(SelectedDispatch.DocumentDate) = MONTH(StockHeader.DocumentDate) AND YEAR(SelectedDispatch.DocumentDate) = YEAR(StockHeader.DocumentDate) WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 {0} Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.StockTransactionID, SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) > SUM(ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, 0)) )tab Where tab.TransactionQty > InvoicedQuantity Order By tab.DispatchDate

data.name: Query_VehicleGatePassReport
data.value:
select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (select null)) AS SrNo,* from ( SELECT distinct 'A' as copy,1 as CopyNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS DealerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, --INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as DocNo2, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.transactionQuantity) Quantity, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description as Item, --CASE WHEN Sal_DOVehicleInformation.Chassis IS NULL THEN SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.Chassis ELSE Sal_DOVehicleInformation.Chassis END AS Chassis, --CASE WHEN Sal_DOVehicleInformation.Engine IS NULL THEN SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.Engine ELSE Sal_DOVehicleInformation.Engine END AS Engine, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as Model, Transporter.CustomerName as TransporterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus,Set_City.CityName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Set_Category ON INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- LEFT JOIN Sal_DOVehicleInformation ON Sal_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.DOVehicleInformationID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.VehicleInformationID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transporter ON SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID = Transporter.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = Transporter.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = Transporter.PeriodID INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 left Join Set_City ON Set_City.CityID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CityID AND Set_City.Status = 1 WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = @CategoryID or @CategoryID is Null) {0} ) as tab -- for DOC number select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (select null)) AS SrNo,* from ( SELECT 1 as CopyNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as DocNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID-- AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Set_Category ON INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- left JOIN Sal_DOVehicleInformation ON Sal_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.DOVehicleInformationID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.VehicleInformationID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transporter ON SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID = Transporter.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = Transporter.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = Transporter.PeriodID INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = @CategoryID or @CategoryID is Null) {0}
union all
SELECT 2 as CopyNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as DocNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Set_Category ON INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- left JOIN Sal_DOVehicleInformation ON Sal_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID AND Sal_DOVehicleInformation.DOVehicleInformationID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.VehicleInformationID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transporter ON SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID = Transporter.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = Transporter.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = Transporter.PeriodID INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = @CategoryID or @CategoryID is Null) {0} ) as tab1

data.name: Query_VehicleStockStatus
data.value:
select isnull(SUM( PRNDO),0) as PRN ,ISNULL( SUM(gatepass) ,0)as GatePass ,ISNULL( SUM(DO) ,0)as DO ,ISNULL(SUM (Dispatch), 0 ) as Dispatch , tab2.ColorName ,description from ( select case when type = 'PRN' then TransactionQuantity end as PRNDO , case when type = 'gatepass' then TransactionQuantity end as Gatepass ,case when type = 'DO' then TransactionQuantity end as DO ,case when type = 'Dispatch' then TransactionQuantity end as Dispatch -- ,tab.Description
, ColorName from (
select
abs( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity ,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description ,'PRN' as type ,Set_Color.ColorName
from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation on SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID
inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join SET_Color on SET_Color.ColorID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.ColorID and SET_Color.status =1 left join SAL_DOVehicleInformation on SAL_DOVehicleInformation.VehicleID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.VehicleID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
where SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @ToDate
union all select
abs( Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity
,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description ,'Gatepass' as Type ,'' as ColorName
from Gate_OutwardHeader inner join Gate_OutwardDetail on Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID and Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID and Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID= Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID and Gate_OutwardDetail.status = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = Gate_OutwardDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Open Returnable Vehicles' and Gate_OutwardHeader.Status =1
where Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID = @PeriodID and Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentDate < @ToDate
union all
select abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity ,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description ,'Dispatch' as type --,'' AS ColorName ,SET_Color.ColorName from Sal_Dispatchheader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Documenttypeid = Sal_Dispatchheader.Documenttypeid AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation on SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.stockheaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.stockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DOVehicleInformation on SAL_DOVehicleInformation.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.DODetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.status = 1
inner join SET_Color on SET_Color.Colorid = SAL_DOVehicleInformation.ColorID and SET_Color.status = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 and Sal_Dispatchheader.status = 1
where Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @PeriodID and Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate < @ToDate
union all
select COUNT (SAL_DOVehicleInformation.ItemID) as TransactionQuantity ,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description ,'DO' as type --,'' as ColorName ,SET_Color.ColorName from SAL_DOVehicleInformation inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_DOVehicleInformation.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Status = 1
inner join SET_Color on SET_Color.ColorID = SAL_DOVehicleInformation.ColorID and SET_COlor.Status = 1
where SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = @PeriodID and SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CreateDate < @ToDate
group by INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description ,ColorName
) tab)as tab2
group by description ,ColorName

data.name: Query_Dispatch_Note
data.value:
SELECT Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber--, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo ,Case SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo When NULL Then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo Else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo End As ContractNo ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_OrderHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber ,brooker.CustomerName as BrokerName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = dbo.SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @currentfiscalid
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer brooker ON brooker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND brooker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID=Transp.PeriodID and Transp.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate left Join SAL_ContractHeader On SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID And SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_SelectAll_WithoutPaging_ForApprove
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.Status ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel ,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as DocumentDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo As DocumentNo ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID Inner Join Sal_OrderDetail On Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID Inner Join Sal_OrderHeader On Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID Left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 {filter} Order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo desc

data.name: Query_Get_DispatchVehicleOmni
data.value:
Select distinct Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo, Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate, [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyNo as Bilty, [SAL_DispatchHeader].RefrenceNo as Chassis, [SAL_DispatchHeader].VehicleNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments as Engine, [SET_City].CityName, [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName as DealerName, ARS.CustomerName As Customer, ARST.CustomerName As Transporter, [SET_Location].LocationName, [SET_VehicleType].TypeName as Vehicletype, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] as ItemCategoryID, [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName as VehicleCategory, [INV_Item].ItemID, [INV_Item].Description as Vehicle, '--' As PSONo, '--' as ColorName, case when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=5 then 'InProcess' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=14 then 'Discuss' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=15 then 'Cancelled' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=16 then 'Reversed' else '' end As [Version]
from [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ARS ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = ARS.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = ARS.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = ARS.[CustomerID] Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[PeriodID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[CompanyID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporters ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporters.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporters.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporters.[CustomerID] left Join AR_Set_Customer ARST ON ARST.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID AND ARST.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND ARST.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN [SET_City] ON [SET_City].[CityID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] AND [SET_City].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] INNER JOIN [SET_VehicleType] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] = [SET_VehicleType].[VehicleTypeID] INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 Where Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.Status = 1 {filter} Order BY Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo asc Select FINTAB.Vehicle, Count(FINTAB.Vehicle) VehicleCount From ( Select distinct Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo, Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate, [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyNo as Bilty, [SAL_DispatchHeader].RefrenceNo as Chassis, [SAL_DispatchHeader].VehicleNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments as Engine, [SET_City].CityName, [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName as DealerName, ARS.CustomerName As Customer, ARST.CustomerName As Transporter, [SET_Location].LocationName, [SET_VehicleType].TypeName as VehicleType, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] , [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName as VehicleCategory, [INV_Item].ItemID, [INV_Item].Description as Vehicle, '--' As P_S_ONo, '--' as ColorName, case when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=5 then 'InProcess' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=14 then 'Discuss' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=15 then 'Cancelled' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=16 then 'Reversed' else '' end As [Version]
from [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ARS ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = ARS.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = ARS.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = ARS.[CustomerID] Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[PeriodID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[CompanyID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporters ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporters.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporters.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporters.[CustomerID] left Join AR_Set_Customer ARST ON ARST.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID AND ARST.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND ARST.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN [SET_City] ON [SET_City].[CityID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] AND [SET_City].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] INNER JOIN [SET_VehicleType] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] = [SET_VehicleType].[VehicleTypeID] INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 Where Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.Status = 1 {filter}
) as FINTAB group by FINTAB.Vehicle
Union All
Select 'Total No Of Dispatches' As Vehicle, Count(FINTAB.Vehicle) AS Count From (
Select distinct Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo, Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchDate, [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyNo as Bilty, [SAL_DispatchHeader].RefrenceNo as Chassis, [SAL_DispatchHeader].VehicleNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments as Engine, [SET_City].CityName, [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName as Dealer, ARS.CustomerName As Customer, ARST.CustomerName As Transporter, [SET_Location].LocationName, [SET_VehicleType].TypeName as VehicleType, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] , [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName as VehicleCategory, [INV_Item].ItemID, [INV_Item].Description as Vehicle, '--' As PSONo, '--' as ColorName, case when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=5 then 'InProcess' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=14 then 'Discuss' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=15 then 'Cancelled' when Sal_Dispatchheader.StatusCode=16 then 'Reversed' else '' end As [Version]
from [SAL_DispatchHeader]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ARS ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = ARS.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = ARS.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = ARS.[CustomerID] Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal_Dispatchheader.DispatchNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[PeriodID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID]=INV_StockTransactionHeader.[CompanyID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporters ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporters.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporters.[PeriodID] And [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporters.[CustomerID] left Join AR_Set_Customer ARST ON ARST.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID AND ARST.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND ARST.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN [SET_City] ON [SET_City].[CityID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] AND [SET_City].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] INNER JOIN [SET_VehicleType] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] = [SET_VehicleType].[VehicleTypeID] INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 Where Sal_Dispatchheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_Dispatchheader.Status = 1 {filter} ) as FINTAB

Select distinct tab.DeliveryOrderID, tab.DeliveryOrderNo, tab.DODate, tab.DocumentType From ( SELECT Distinct SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate, StockHeader.StockTransactionID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, 0)) as InvoicedQuantity, Cast(( ( select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ) * -1) AS Decimal(18, 0))TransactionQty FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1
LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID
INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] IS NULL
Group By SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) ) tab Where tab.TransactionQty > InvoicedQuantity Order By tab.DeliveryOrderNo

DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, ISNULL(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) as TransactionQuantity, INV_Item.Description as item, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus from SAL_OrderHeader inner join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID and SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID and SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 and SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.itemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryORderDetail.DOHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = SAL_DeliveryORderDetail.DODetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID left JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%' where SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and data.name: Query_SelectAll_WithoutPaging_ForApproveLeftJoin
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID, SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID, SAL_DispatchHeader.Status, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as DocumentDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo As DocumentNo ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID Left Join Sal_OrderDetail On Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID Left Join Sal_OrderHeader On Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID Left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 {filter} Order by Cast(Dispatch.DispatchNo as int) desc

select GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description ,DispatchDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, GrossWeight, TareWeight, NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SUM( ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitWeight, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * 1 end )) as Weight, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid and SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = set_documenttype.CompanyID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group By GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, GrossWeight, TareWeight, NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, Dispatchdate,sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName

data.value: SELECT DISTINCT SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.Status ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT dh.TotalAmount FROM SAL_DispatchHeader dh WHERE dh.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND dh.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND dh.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID =
