SELECT row_number() over(partition by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) as Row_No, Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_OrderHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber ,INV_Item.UnitVolume ,SET_RoundingControlType.Description as BinType ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno ,AR_SET_Customer.CollectorContactNumber as VendorNo
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID --Left JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --AND SET_Company.Status=1 left JOIN SET_RoundingControlType On SET_RoundingControlType.RoundingControlTypeID = INV_Item.RoundingControlTypeID AND SET_RoundingControlType.Status=1 left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID=Transp.PeriodID and Transp.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1

SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID --Left JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --AND SET_Company.Status=1 left JOIN SET_RoundingControlType On data.name: Query_GetDispatchMBIThreeData
data.value:
SELECT row_number() over(partition by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) as Row_No, Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_OrderHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber ,INV_Item.UnitVolume ,SET_RoundingControlType.Description as BinType ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno ,AR_SET_Customer.CollectorContactNumber as VendorNo ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomerSTRN ,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN ,[SET_OperatingUnit].OperatingUnitName as SupplierName ,[SET_OperatingUnit].NTNNumber as SupplierNTN ,[SET_OperatingUnit].SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN ,[SET_OperatingUnit].AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo as OrderNo ,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate as OrderDate ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID --Left JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --AND SET_Company.Status=1 left JOIN SET_RoundingControlType On SET_RoundingControlType.RoundingControlTypeID = INV_Item.RoundingControlTypeID AND SET_RoundingControlType.Status=1 left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID=Transp.PeriodID and Transp.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_ToGet_DispatchForReversal
data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], max(SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno) as referenceno, --'' as referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) - SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ReversedQuantity, 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) * -1) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty ,(select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity),0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = StockHeader.stockTransactionID -- and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID
) as ReverseQty
FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 LEft JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled] <> 1 and isnull([SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComplet,0) <> 1 {0}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID
HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity] * -1) > (SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) - SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ReversedQuantity, 0))) )tab Where tab.TransactionQty > (InvoicedQuantity+ReverseQty) Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_GetDataForDispatchByLoadingNo
data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID], ISNULL( ( {0} -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] left join INV_StockTransactionDetail recvQty on recvQty.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHEaderID and recvQty.companyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.companyID and recvQty.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID Where DODetail.[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and DODetail.[DODetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID Group BY DODetail.Quantity ) -- - -- ( --case when (select sum(ReversedQuantity) from sal_ReverseDetail -- where sal_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DoheaderID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].PeriodID) is null then 0 else -- (select sum(ReversedQuantity) from sal_ReverseDetail -- where sal_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DoheaderID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID -- and sal_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].PeriodID) -- end
-- ) , 0) [Quantity2], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity] as BaseQty, [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[IsCancelled], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CancellationDate], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CancelledBy], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[IsApproved], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[ApprovedBy], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[ApproveDate], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[IsPaid], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PaidAmount], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CreatedBy], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CreateDate], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CreatedByValue], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[UpdatedBy], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[UpdateDate], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[UpdatedByValue], [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID], [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID], [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID], [SAL_OrderDetail].[Quantity] AS [BaseQuantity], [SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate], [SAL_OrderDetail].[BaseAmount],Set_Batch.Description as Batch, (Case when [SAL_OrderDetail].Inclusive = 1 then [SAL_OrderDetail].GrossAmount else [SAL_OrderDetail].[NetAmount] end) as NetAmount , SAL_Contractdetail.Quantity as SOQuantity,
(SAL_Contractdetail.[Quantity] * [SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) AS [Amount], Set_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,Set_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName], [INV_Item].[Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit, ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] * (ISNULL( ( {0} -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail recvQty on recvQty.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHEaderID and recvQty.companyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.companyID and recvQty.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID Where DODetail.[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and DODetail.[DODetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID Group BY DODetail.Quantity ), 0)), 0) AS TotalAmount, isnull((Select (Quantity - ABS(isnull(TransactionQuantity,0))) + isnull(ReversedQuantity,0) as RemainingQty from ( Select SourceCode,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity , sum(Dodtl.Quantity) + (sum(Dodtl.Quantity) * isnull(INV_Item.QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0) / 100 ) as Quantity ,Reversed.ReversedQuantity from [INV_StockTransactionDetail] Inner Join [INV_StockTransactionHeader] on [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].Status=1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] Dodtl ON Dodtl.[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND Dodtl.[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND Dodtl.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND Dodtl.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND Dodtl.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] SalDaliveryOrder ON SalDaliveryOrder.[DeliveryOrderID] = Dodtl.[DOHeaderID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[CompanyID] = Dodtl.[CompanyID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[PeriodID] = Dodtl.[PeriodID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SalDaliveryOrder.[Status] = 1
left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity),0) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) Reversed on Reversed.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and Reversed .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and Reversed .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and Reversed .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID]
Where SalDaliveryOrder.DeliveryOrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderID and SalDaliveryOrder.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].CompanyID and Dodtl.DODetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID And [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Status=1
Group By SourceCode,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID,Reversed.ReversedQuantity ) as RemainingQty), [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity) RemainingQty, '' [Action],INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID, [RackName] ,SET_Location.[LocationID],[LocationName],[SAL_OrderDetail].Inclusive ,Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID,Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo ,INV_LoadingPointDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity FROM [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] inner join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader on Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.companyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].companyID and Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].PeriodID INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID]
inner join SAL_Contractdetail on SAL_Contractdetail.ContractID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .ContractHeaderID and SAL_Contractdetail.ContractDetailID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .ContractDetailID and SAL_Contractdetail.CompanyID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .CompanyID and SAL_Contractdetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --AND Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 left join Set_ItemCatalog on Set_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LocationID WHERE [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = @DeliveryOrderID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 and INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo = @GrossWtDoc and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {2} and ISNULL( ( -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - (ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) - isnull(sum(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity),0)) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID

data.value:
Select Convert(int, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) As DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,
SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -INV_StockTransactionDetail.amount else SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount end ) as TotalAmount,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end
) as Dispatch_TransactionQuantity, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -(INV_StockTransactionDetail.amount * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) else (SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) end ) as SAL_FEDAmount, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -(SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount) else SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount end) as SalGrosssAmount , (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount else SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount end) as SalNetAmount, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) else isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) end ) as SAL_FedRate , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Agent.CustomerName as AgentName, SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID, Transaporter.CustomerName as TransporterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII as ManualCNIC, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII as ManualName, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus ,SAL_OrderHeader.TotalAmount as GrandTotal ,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo) as SaleOrderNo ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,RackName,LocationName from SAL_DispatchHeader
inner join AR_SET_Customer on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID --And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID
left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Left join AR_SET_Customer Transaporter on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Transaporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Transaporter.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transaporter.Status = 1
Left join AR_SET_Customer Agent on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Agent.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Agent.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID and Transaporter.Status = 1
left join set_city on set_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID
inner join Set_Location on Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID
inner join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_WeightVarianceReport
data.value:
Select Convert(int, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) As DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,
SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -INV_StockTransactionDetail.amount else SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount end ) as TotalAmount,
(Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end
) as Dispatch_TransactionQuantity, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -(INV_StockTransactionDetail.amount * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) else (SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount * isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) end ) as SAL_FEDAmount, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -(SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount) else SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount end) as SalGrosssAmount , (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount else SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount end) as SalNetAmount, (Case When SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is not null then -isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) else isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) end ) as SAL_FedRate , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Agent.CustomerName as AgentName, SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID, Transaporter.CustomerName as TransporterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII as ManualCNIC, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII as ManualName, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus ,SAL_OrderHeader.TotalAmount as GrandTotal ,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo as SaleOrderNo,INV_Item.Description AS Item ,case when ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume,0) > 0 then ROund((ABS(SUM(TransactionQuantity)) * INV_Item.UnitVolume),0) else 0 end as EstimatedWeight ,case when ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume,0) > 0 then Round(ISNULL(SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight - (ABS(SUM(TransactionQuantity)) * INV_Item.UnitVolume),0),0) else 0 end as WeightDifference from SAL_DispatchHeader
inner join AR_SET_Customer on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
left join SAL_OrderDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID --And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID
left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderId AND SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Left join AR_SET_Customer Transaporter on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Transaporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Transaporter.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transaporter.Status = 1
Left join AR_SET_Customer Agent on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Agent.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Agent.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID and Transaporter.Status = 1 left join set_city on set_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
{0}
group by INV_ITem.UnitVolume,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight,DocumentType,SAl_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount,SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,Agent.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID,Transaporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII,SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode, SAL_OrderHeader.TotalAmount,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName,Set_Batch.Description,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo,INV_Item.Description

)Invoice group by CustomerPoNo FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As CustomerPoNo

inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = Do.DOHeaderID And Do.DODetailID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And Do.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And Do.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)Invoice group by CustomerPoDate FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As CustomerPoDate
,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT ', ' + Convert(Varchar,SourceCode,3) AS 'data()' from (

)DO group by DO.SourceCode FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) ) as DeliveryOrderNo --,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO as CustomerCallPO2 , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate as CustomerCallPODate2 FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ANd Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Inv_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1

,SAL_GateIn.DriverName as DrName,SAL_GateIn.CNICNO,SAL_GateIn.LICNo,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo as VihclNo ,SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID as FiscalID ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as GrossWtNo from SAL_GateIn inner join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_GateIn.VehicleTypeID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID
) abctype on abctype.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and abctype.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and abctype.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and abctype.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.fiscalID and abctype.GrossWtNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID {0}
left Join SAL_ContractHeader On SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where abctype.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID group by [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[TransporterID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleNo] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsDirectDispatch],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CNIC],AR_SET_Customer.[CustomerName] ,SET_City.CityName,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[PaymentType],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DriverName],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DriverCNIC] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DriverContactNumber],Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,Transporter.CustomerName,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage,SET_Business.AddressLine2,[Inv_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].NetWeight --,SAL_GateIn.DriverName,SAL_GateIn.CNICNO,SAL_GateIn.LICNo,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo
