data.name: Query_GetGatePassMBSM_HSM
data.value:
select distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, --INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ( case when INV_SET_Category.CategoryName = 'Sugar' then 'Refined Sugar' else INV_SET_Category.CategoryName end ) as CategoryName ,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, --sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, ceiling(GrossWeight) GrossWeight, ceiling(TareWeight) TareWeight, ceiling(NetWeight)NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount --, SUM( -- ( -- Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode -- then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitVolume, 1) -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitWeight, 1) -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * 1 end --)) as Weight , -- case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName --else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName + ' A/C ' + isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName,ar_set_Customer.CustomerName) end as CustomerName
--case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else CustomerParty.CustomerName end as CustomerName
case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName [TransporterName], case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber) else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end as [CNIC] , SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate [DispatchTime] --,(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) Quantity ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end as AddressLine1 ,abctype.TypeName ,max(abctype.LoadingTime)LoadingTime ,SET_Business.BusinessName as BusinessName, SET_Business.AddressLine2, INV_Item.primaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight,INV_Item.UnitVolume , case when (select count(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1) > 1 then ( ''+ convert(varchar,isnull((select min(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1),'')) + '-' + convert(varchar,isnull((select max(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1),'')) + '' ) else GatePassNo end as GatePassNo
,STUFF( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + (case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else CustomerParty.CustomerName end ) + ' ' + (case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end )
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr inner join SAL_DispatchHeader dishdr on dishdr.DocumentTypeID = stkHdr .DocumentTypeID and dishdr.DispatchNo = stkHdr .DocumentNo and dishdr.FiscalID = stkHdr .FiscalID and dishdr.CompanyID = stkHdr .CompanyID
inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = dishdr.CustomerID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = dishdr.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = dishdr.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = dishdr.PeriodID
where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1 and stkHdr.StatusCode = 1
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') as CustomerName
,(select sum(abs(dtl.TransactionQuantity)) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail dtl on dtl.StockTransactionID = stkHdr.StockTransactionID and dtl.CompanyID = stkHdr.CompanyID and dtl.Status = 1 where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1 and stkHdr.StatusCode = 1 ) as Quantity ,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT ', ' + Convert(Varchar,SourceCode,3) AS 'data()' from (
select ch.SourceCode from Inv_StockTransactionDetail ch
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = ch.SourceHeaderID And ch.SourceLineID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And ch.SourceCode = inv_dtl.SourceCode And ch.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And ch.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)DO group by DO.SourceCode FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) ) as DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID
inner join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
left join ( Select TypeName,DOHeaderID,DODetailID,SAL_GateIn.CompanyID,Format(INV_LoadingPointHeader.CreateDate, 'hh:mm tt')LoadingTime,Quantity ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as SecondWeightID ,SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID as FiscalID ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as GrossWtNo from SAL_GateIn inner join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_GateIn.VehicleTypeID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID
) abctype on abctype.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and abctype.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and abctype.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and abctype.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.fiscalID and abctype.GrossWtNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid and SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = set_documenttype.CompanyID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and CategoryID = @CategoryID and abctype.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID {0} Group By GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, GrossWeight, TareWeight, NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.Dispatchdate, --sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress,abctype.TypeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine2 ,INV_Item.primaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight,INV_Item.UnitVolume,CustomerParty.CustomerName,abctype.Quantity,CustomerParty.AddressLine1 ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail .SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID ,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID

data.name: Query_SaleTaxInvoiceSummary
data.value:
Select * from ( Select ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, --AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, 0) = 1 THEN SET_City.CityName ELSE [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyAddress END ) AS CustomerAddress ,
AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * isnull(inv_item.UnitWeight,0) / isnull(inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1) as MtonQty, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG as PricePerKG, case when SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail is not null then SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end as PricePerKG, inv_item.UnitWeight, inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * -- Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' and SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 72.0 and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' ) --then --[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] --else [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate END -- / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)
THEN
( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) )) )
- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
-- ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * -- case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
--,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable,
--,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- and --isnull((select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1),0) > 0
--then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive --else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) -- end as AmountReceivable,
, ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * CASE WHEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, 0)) > 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, 0)) ELSE ( ( CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL THEN SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG ELSE SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG END ) + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) THEN 3.60 ELSE 0 END ) ) END )) )- [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding as AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
Union All

SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * isnull(inv_item.UnitWeight,0) / isnull(inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1) as MtonQty, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG as PricePerKG, inv_item.UnitWeight, inv_item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * -- Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' and SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 72.0 and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' ) --then --[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] --else [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate END -- / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)
THEN
( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) )) )
- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
-- ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * -- case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
--,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable,
,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 and isnull((select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1),0) > 0
then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) end as AmountReceivable,

data.name: Query_Sales_Register_Report
data.value:
Select * from ( Select Set_Batch.Description as BatchName, Set_Batch.BatchID, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
--, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * -- Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' and SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 72.0 and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' ) --then --[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] --else [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate END -- / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate <=

--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) = 1
then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
((( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) - --WithHolding --((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice )* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / 100 ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) * ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)
) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount)) end )as SaleTaxAmount
--,(case when ( -- SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
-- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate -- else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) -- end ) -- )
-- then

-- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity -- else -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) -- end)
-- end) -- else -- (([SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100)) -- end -- ) as SaleTaxAmount
, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount
, (
-- Reward Start --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * ((sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight)))) -- Reward End
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice
)
* ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) as WithHoldingAmount
,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
-- ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * -- case when -- ( -- COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 and -- isnull((select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = 2 and CompanyID = (1) and PeriodID = 1 and Status = 1),0) > 0 -- ) --then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG --)end))) As AmountReceivable,
,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * ((sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight))))
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice )) end as AmountReceivable,

-- then

-- else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ -- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity -- else -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) -- end)
-- end) -- else

--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo, SAL_ContractHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,Convert(decimal(18,4),SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail) as FreightDetail , isnull((select InvoiceID from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID in @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1 group by InvoiceID having SUM(AdvanceAmount) > 0),0) as AdvanceID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode ,isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON data.name: Query_SaleInvoiceDetailWithCNIC
data.value:
---DECLARE @CompanyID INT --DECLARE @PeriodID INT --DECLARE @CurrentFiscalID INT
--SET @CompanyID = 1 --SET @PeriodID = 1 --SET @CurrentFiscalID = 1
SELECT CompanyID , InvoiceType , InvoiceNumber as No , SINumber as InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, DealerName , DealerID, CustomerName , BuyerAddress , CNICNumber , ContractNo , ContractDate as SaleOrderDate , SUM(Quantity) AS QuantityInvoiced , sum(AmountReceivable-(WithHolding+ExciseDutyActualAmount+SaleTaxAmount)) AS ValueExcTax , sum(SaleTaxAmount) AS SalesTax , sum(ExciseDutyActualAmount) AS FurtherTax , sum(AmountReceivable-WithHolding) As ValueIncAllTax, sum(WithHolding) AS WithHoldingAmount , sum(AmountReceivable) AS AmountReceivable ,NTNNumberNew as NTNNumber ,PricePerKG as UnitPrice ,DocumentTypeID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS DealerName , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AS DealerID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo AS DeliveryOrderNo , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight AS Quantity , ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount AS ExciseDutyActualAmount , --CASE WHEN ( SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate > '2019-07-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > CASE -- WHEN ( AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 -- OR AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 -- ) THEN 70.2 -- ELSE 70.3404 -- END -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- ) -- THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG, -- SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG, -- SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) --END AS SaleTaxAmount , case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount, ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount AS FEDTaxAmount , ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) THEN 3.60 ELSE 0 END ) ) ) ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) AS WithHoldingAmount , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced , INV_Item.UnitWeight ,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount AS SalesTaxPer , SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount AS FEDTaxPer , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding AS WithHoldingTaxPer , SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount AS ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate , ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * CASE WHEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, 0)) > 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 6), ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail, 0)) ELSE ( ( CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL THEN SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG ELSE SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG END ) + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) THEN 3.60 ELSE 0 END ) ) END )) ) AS AmountReceivable , SET_Business.BusinessName AS SupplierName , SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS SupplierNameComplete , SET_Business.AddressLine1 AS SupplierAddress , SET_Business.NTNNumber AS SupplierNTN , SET_Business.PhoneNumber AS SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber AS SupplierSTRN , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid , BC.CustomerName AS BIllTo , CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, 0) = 1 THEN AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ELSE (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%sugar%' Then [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII Else Sal_DispatchHeader.DriverName end) END AS CustomerName , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress , AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber AS CustomerNTN , AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhoneNumber , AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber AS CustomeSTRN , CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, 0) = 1 THEN AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ELSE (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%sugar%' Then [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII Else Sal_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end) END AS CNICNumber , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo AS DispatchNo , INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode AS ItemStatusCode , INV_SET_Category.CategoryName , ABS([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] , [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost AS UnitPrice , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount] , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount , [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount] , ( ( ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, 0) - ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken, 0) ) * ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount], 0) ) / 100 AS TaxPayable , ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ( ( ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, 0) - ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken, 0) ) * ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount], 0) ) / 100 ) - ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken, 0) AS TotalAmount , NULL AS LogoImage , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress AS Shipto , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description AS DescriptionTagNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken , ( CASE DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName WHEN 'Head Office-KHI' THEN 'K' + 'SI' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), ( CASE WHEN AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 THEN 'E' ELSE ( CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Un-R%' THEN 'U' ELSE 'R' END ) END )) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + SET_OperatingUnit.UnitPrefix + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) WHEN NULL THEN '-' + ' ' + 'SI' + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + SET_OperatingUnit.UnitPrefix + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) ELSE SUBSTRING(GroupName, 1, 1) + 'SI' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), ( CASE WHEN AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 THEN 'E' ELSE ( CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Un-R%' THEN 'U' ELSE 'R' END ) END )) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + SET_OperatingUnit.UnitPrefix + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) END ) AS SINumber , SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno AS CustomerRefNo , SET_Business.AddressLine1 , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding , SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount , CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL THEN SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo ELSE SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo END AS ContractNo , CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL THEN SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate ELSE SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate END AS ContractDate , ( CASE WHEN SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo IS NULL THEN ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate, 0) ) ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) , 0) ) END ) AS ActualInvoiceAmount , SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate , SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo , SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount AS TAmountReceivable , SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID , Brokername.CustomerName AS BrokerName , SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS UnitAddress , SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS UnitPhoneNo , SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS UnitFaxNo , Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory AS BrokerCategory , SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(AdvanceAmount) FROM SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment WHERE SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ), 0) AdvanceAmount , ( SELECT DISTINCT STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), u.AdvancePaymentID) FROM SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u WHERE u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID AND u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') AS userlist FROM SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment WHERE SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID GROUP BY AdvancePaymentID ) AS PaymentReference , ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(WHAdvance) FROM SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment WHERE SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ), 0) WHAdvance , ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) FROM SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment WHERE SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ), 0) FurtherTaxAdvance , SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo , UPPER(SUBSTRING(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, 0, 5)) AS CustomerPrefix , SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo , SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate , ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive, SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) AS Rate , Set_Batch.Description AS CropYear , ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, 0) = 1 THEN SET_City.CityName ELSE [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyAddress END ) AS BuyerAddress , SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo , SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumberNew --, SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG as PricePerKG , case when SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail is not null then SAL_ContractHeader.FreightDetail else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end as PricePerKG
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID LEFT JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractDetail ON SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax ON Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId AND SET_Business.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup ON DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = SET_DocumentType.GroupID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.status = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) ) FinalTAB WHERE {0}
GROUP BY CompanyID ,InvoiceType ,InvoiceNumber ,DealerName ,CustomerName ,BuyerAddress ,CNICNumber ,ContractNo ,ContractDate ,InvoiceDate,SINUMber,NTNNumberNew,PricePerKG,DocumentTypeID,DealerID
Order bY FinalTAB.CustomerName,FinalTAB.InvoiceDate, FinalTAB.InvoiceNumber

data.name: Query_GetData_byKey_ForStatusChange
data.value: SELECT * FROM SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID WHERE SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and DeliveryOrderID = @DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_Dispatch_Note_HSM
data.value:
SELECT Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, tbl_Broker.CustomerName as AgentDealer, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty , INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance , tbl_Broker.CustomerName as AgentDealer ,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SET_Location.LocationName ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_ContractHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_ContractHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = dbo.SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @currentfiscalid
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season LEFT JOIN [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_ContractDetail.[Status] = 1 AND SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_ContractDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID Inner join AR_SET_Customer as tbl_Broker on tbl_Broker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID AND tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and tbl_Broker.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1
