data.name: Query_GetDataForGatePassEthonalReport
data.value:
Select SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID, SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName , SET_Location.LocationName, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.SealNoFrom, SAL_DispatchHeader.SealNoTo ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate,INV_Item.Description as Description ,SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID,SET_VehicleType.TypeName as ModeOfTransport,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, case when SET_Documenttype.Documenttype = 'Dispatch - Ethanol - Local' then [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate else '' end As RatePerliter from SAL_DispatchHeader
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 inner join SET_Documenttype on SET_Documenttype.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_Documenttype.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_Documenttype.periodId = SAL_DispatchHeader.periodId
INNER JOIN INV_SecondWeight ON INV_SecondWeight.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID AND INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_SecondWeight.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_LoadingPointHeader ON INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_FirstWeight ON INV_FirstWeight.FirstWeightID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo AND INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID AND INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID AND INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID AND INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_FirstWeight.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SAL_GateIn ON SAL_GateIn.GateInID = INV_FirstWeight.GateINID AND SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType AND SAL_GateIn.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID AND SAL_GateIn.PeriodID = INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID AND SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_GateIn.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_LoadingPointDetail ON INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID AND INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID AND INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID AND INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_LoadingPointDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 --LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --and Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID --AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID left join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_GateIn.VehicleTypeID And SET_VehicleType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 left join set_location on set_location.LocationID=SAL_DispatchHeader.[LocationID] left join set_rack on set_rack.rackID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID]
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_VehicleWiseWeighment_Report
data.value:
select DocumentTypeID,VehicleNo,TareWeight,GrossWeight,NetWeight,sum(Quantity) as Quantity,TokenNo,max(BiltyNo)as BiltyNo,max(UnitWeight)as UnitWeight from ( Select distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight * -1 else SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight end
) as TareWeight,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight * -1 else SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight end
) as GrossWeight,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then (SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight- SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight) * -1 else SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight- SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight end
) as NetWeight,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then (ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))) * -1 else (ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))) end
) as Quantity,
SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo ,(SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo)as BiltyNo , (INV_Item.UnitVolume) as UnitWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID from SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.Itemid = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Itemid
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.status = 1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
inner join SAL_SecondWeight on SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo and SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenType = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenTypeID and SAL_SecondWeight.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_SecondWeight.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SAL_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 {0}
--group by SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight -- ,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight- SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo )as tab group by VehicleNo,TareWeight,GrossWeight,NetWeight,TokenNo,DocumentTypeID

LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker ON tbl_Broker.BrokerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID AND tbl_Broker.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND tbl_Broker.Status = 1

where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate BETWEEN SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate {0} UNION ALL
SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, tbl_Broker.CustomerName AS BrokerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID ,0 AS LiftingOfThePeriod ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS Lifting FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker ON tbl_Broker.BrokerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID AND tbl_Broker.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND tbl_Broker.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom ON SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} )tab GROUP BY tab.BrokerName, tab.CustomerName, tab.DocumentTypeID

Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.NetWeight,DispatchNo --,case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as CustomerName ,ar_set_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName [TransporterName], case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber) else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as [CNIC] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate [DispatchTime],(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) Quantity ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress --, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII end as CustomerAddress ,SET_Business.BusinessName as BusinessName, SET_Business.AddressLine2,Set_Batch.Description as Batch, tbl_Broker.CustomerName as BrokerName, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII as DriverName, --SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber, format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverContactNumber, '-',''),0)),'0###-#######') as DriverContactNumber, --SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII as DriverCNIC, format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') as DriverCNIC ,SET_VehicleType.TypeName, isnull(SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII,'') as DriverAddress, ISNULL(SAL_DispatchHeader.UpdatedByValue,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,SAL_Token.DriverName AS TokenDriverName ,format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace(SAL_Token.CNICNO, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') as TokenDriverCNICNo ,format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace(SAL_Token.DriverMobileNo, '-',''),0)),'0###-#######') as TokenDriverMobileNo
from SAL_DispatchHeader
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID --and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID
inner join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Left Join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker ON tbl_Broker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID And tbl_Broker.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader On SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_Token ON SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenTypeID And SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo And SAL_Token.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And SAL_Token.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And SAL_Token.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And SAL_Token.Status = 1
Inner Join SAL_SecondWeight On SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenNo = SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo And SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenType = SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID And SAL_SecondWeight.CompanyID = SAL_Token.CompanyID And SAL_SecondWeight.PeriodID = SAL_Token.PeriodID And SAL_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_Token.CurrentFiscalID And SAL_SecondWeight.Status = 1
Left join SET_VehicleType On SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_Token.VehicleTypeID AND SET_VehicleType.Status = 1
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and CategoryID = @CategoryID {0}
Group By GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo,DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.Dispatchdate,sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine2 ,Set_Batch.Description, tbl_Broker.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.NetWeight ,SET_VehicleType.TypeName,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII,SAL_DispatchHeader.UpdatedByValue,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreatedByValue ,SAL_Token.DriverName, SAL_Token.CNICNO, SAL_Token.DriverMobileNo order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID

data.name: Query_DispatchReturnReport
data.value:
Select SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,tbl_Broker.CustomerName as BrokerName, SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate as DocumentDate ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderNo as DONo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemName, ISNULL(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0)DispatchQty,SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, (select distinct top 1 SET_Location.LocationName from INV_StockTransactionDetail as INV_StockTransactionDetail2 inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader as INV_StockTransactionHeader2 on INV_StockTransactionHeader2.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail2.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail2.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail2.PeriodID
inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID=INV_StockTransactionDetail2.LocationID where INV_StockTransactionHeader2.DocumentNo=SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.DocumentTypeID=SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader2.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID ) as LocationName, isnull(SET_Rack.RackName,tbl_Rack.RackName) as RackName, SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity as ReturnQty
from SAL_ReverseDetail
Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceLineID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_DispatchHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker on tbl_Broker.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID And tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --And tbl_Broker.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And tbl_Broker.Status = 1
left Join INV_Item On INV_ITem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = SAL_ReverseDetail.RackID and SET_Rack.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack as tbl_Rack on tbl_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID and tbl_Rack.Status = 1
Where SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
{0}

data.name: Query_CustomerWiseLiftingReport
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,case SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DeliveryOrderStatus ,[SET_Batch].[Description] as Batch ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchID] ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DispatchStatus ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CompanyID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[PeriodID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DocumentTypeID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[VehicleNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[BiltyNo] --,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.[Quantity] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[GrossWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TareWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[NetWeight] ,[INV_Item].[Description] --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty ,IsNull(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure as [Quantity] --,(dbo.SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity * dbo.INV_Item.UnitWeight / ISNULL(dbo.INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) / 50)as Bags ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) as Bags
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
inner join [SET_Batch] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[Season] = [SET_Batch].[BatchID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_Batch].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_Batch].[PeriodID] AND [SET_Batch].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_DispatchDetailReportNew_forDispatch
data.value:
Select Distinct Convert(int, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) As DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount as TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.ContainerNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.ColorByHazelScale,
(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end
) as Dispatch_TransactionQuantity,
(SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount * isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) / (100 + isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FEDAmount, 0)) as SAL_FEDAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.GrossAmount as SalGrosssAmount , SAL_ContractDetail.NetAmount as SalNetAmount, isnull(SAL_ContractDetail.FEDAmount, 0) as SAL_FedRate , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Agent.CustomerName as AgentName, SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID, SAL_DispatchHeader.ContainerNo, Transaporter.CustomerName as TransporterName, ISNULL(SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC) as ManualCNIC, tbl_CutomerParty.CustomerName as ManualName, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus ,SAL_ContractHeader.TotalAmount as GrandTotal ,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName, isnull(Set_Batch.Description, INV_LoadingPointDetail.Comments) as Batch ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo as SaleOrderNo , LossInTransitQty as TransitLoss, QuantityInvoiced as DeliveryWeight, Set_Rack.RackName from SAL_DispatchHeader inner join AR_SET_Customer on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOdetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID --And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.FiscalID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID --and Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left join AR_SET_Customer Transaporter on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Transaporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Transaporter.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transaporter.Status = 1 Left join AR_SET_Customer Agent on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Agent.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Agent.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID and Transaporter.Status = 1 left Join AR_SET_Customer tbl_CutomerParty on tbl_CutomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and tbl_CutomerParty.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and tbl_CutomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and tbl_CutomerParty.Status = 1 left join set_city on set_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID left Join Set_Rack on Set_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID and Set_Rack.Status = 1
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
Group by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress,SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SAL_ContractDetail.FEDAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.GrossAmount,SAL_ContractDetail.NetAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Agent.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID, Transaporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,SAL_ContractHeader.TotalAmount,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName,Set_Batch.Description,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo, Set_Rack.RackName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.LossInTransitQty,SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, tbl_CutomerParty.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC, INV_LoadingPointDetail.Comments, SAL_DispatchHeader.ContainerNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.ColorByHazelScale
Order by CAST(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as int) asc

data.name: Query_ForTareWeight
data.value:
SELECT [SAL_ReverseHeader].ReverseHeaderID as [StockTransactionID], [SAL_ReverseHeader].DocumentNo as [DispatchNo], [SAL_ReverseHeader].CreateDate as [DispatchDate], '' as referenceno, --'' as referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as StockQuantity, 0 as InvoicedQuantity ,0 as TransactionQty ,0 as ReverseQty
FROM [SAL_ReverseHeader]
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_ReverseHeader].DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_ReverseHeader].CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_ReverseHeader].PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%'

left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID

) as Dispatch_TransactionQuantity,

AgentName, SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID, SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID, Transaporter.CustomerName as TransporterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC as ManualCNIC, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName as ManualName, Case Sal_DispatchHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus ,SAL_ContractHeader.TotalAmount as GrandTotal ,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,set_city.CityName, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo as SaleOrderNo , LossInTransitQty as TransitLoss, QuantityInvoiced as DeliveryWeight, Set_Rack.RackName ,isnull(inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode,'')+''+ INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription from SAL_DispatchHeader inner join AR_SET_Customer on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID --And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID Inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID left JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] and INV_Item.Status = 1 left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.FiscalID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left join AR_SET_Customer Transaporter on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Transaporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Transaporter.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transaporter.Status = 1 Left join AR_SET_Customer Agent on --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Agent.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Agent.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.AgentDealerID and Transaporter.Status = 1 left join set_city on set_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID left Join Set_Rack on Set_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID and Set_Rack.Status = 1

Order by CAST(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as int) asc

select SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, ceiling(GrossWeight) GrossWeight, ceiling(TareWeight) TareWeight, ceiling(NetWeight)NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SUM( ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitWeight, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * 1 end )) as Weight, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else SAL_Token.DriverName + ' A/C ' + ar_set_Customer.CustomerName end as CustomerName , case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName [TransporterName],tbl_Broker.CustomerName [BrokerName], ar_set_Customer.STRNNumber,ar_set_Customer.NTNNumber,ar_set_Customer.CNICNumber, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber) else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end as [CNIC] , SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate [DispatchTime],(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) Quantity ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress end as AddressLine1 ,SET_VehicleType.TypeName,SAL_Token.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber ,null as LoadingTime ,SET_Business.BusinessName as BusinessName, SET_Business.AddressLine2,Set_Batch.Description as Batch --,(SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO + ' / ' + isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPONo,'')) as CustomerCallPO,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate ,(SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo) as CustomerCallPO ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate CustomerCallPODate
from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID --and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
inner join ar_set_Customer as tbl_Broker on tbl_Broker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID and tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] --AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[FiscalID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[FiscalID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID
INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[FiscalID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[FiscalID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_OrderHeader.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractDetail ON SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractHeader.status = 1
inner join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid inner Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = 2
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID
inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
inner join SAL_Token on SAL_Token.SaletokenNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo and SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenTypeID
left join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_Token.VehicleTypeID
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and CategoryID = @CategoryID and SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {0} Group By SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, GrossWeight, TareWeight, NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.Dispatchdate,sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName, tbl_Broker.CustomerName,ar_set_Customer.STRNNumber,ar_set_Customer.NTNNumber,ar_set_Customer.CNICNumber,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC,SAL_Token.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine2 ,Set_Batch.Description,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate,SET_VehicleType.TypeName,SAL_Token.DriverName order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID

data.name: Query_SaleInvoiceDetailWithCNIC_Steel
data.value:
---DECLARE @CompanyID INT --DECLARE @PeriodID INT --DECLARE @CurrentFiscalID INT
--SET @CompanyID = 1 --SET @PeriodID = 1 --SET @CurrentFiscalID = 1
SELECT CompanyID , InvoiceType , InvoiceNumber as No , SINumber as InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, DealerName , DealerID, CustomerName , BuyerAddress , CNICNumber , ContractNo , ContractDate as SaleOrderDate , SUM(Quantity) AS QuantityInvoiced , case when Inclusive = 1 then sum(AmountReceivable - TaxPayable - WithHoldingAmount ) else sum(AmountReceivable ) end AS ValueExcTax , sum(SaleTaxAmount) AS SalesTax , sum(ExciseDutyActualAmount) AS FurtherTax , sum(AmountReceivable-WithHolding) As ValueIncAllTax, sum(WithHoldingAmount) AS WithHoldingAmount , sum(AmountReceivable) AS AmountReceivable ,NTNNumberNew as NTNNumber ,PricePerKG as UnitPrice ,DocumentTypeID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS DealerName , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AS DealerID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo AS DeliveryOrderNo , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight AS Quantity , ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount AS ExciseDutyActualAmount , --CASE WHEN ( SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate > '2019-07-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > CASE -- WHEN ( AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 -- OR AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 -- ) THEN 70.2 -- ELSE 70.3404 -- END -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- ) -- THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG, -- SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG, -- SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) --END AS SaleTaxAmount , SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then --SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No --SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else

ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] left join INV_StockTransactionDetail recvQty on recvQty.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHEaderID and recvQty.companyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.companyID and recvQty.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID Where DODetail.[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and DODetail.[DODetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID Group BY DODetail.Quantity ) -- - (SAL_Contractdetail.[Quantity] * [SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) AS [Amount], Set_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,Set_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName], [INV_Item].[Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit, ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] * (ISNULL( ( {0} -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail recvQty on recvQty.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHEaderID and recvQty.companyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.companyID and recvQty.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID Where DODetail.[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and DODetail.[DODetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID Group BY DODetail.Quantity ), 0)), 0) AS TotalAmount, isnull((Select (Quantity - ABS(isnull(TransactionQuantity,0))) + isnull(ReversedQuantity,0) as RemainingQty from ( Select SourceCode,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity , sum(Dodtl.Quantity) + (sum(Dodtl.Quantity) * isnull(INV_Item.QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0) / 100 ) as Quantity ,Sum(Reversed.ReversedQuantity)ReversedQuantity from [INV_StockTransactionDetail] Inner Join [INV_StockTransactionHeader] on [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].Status=1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] Dodtl ON Dodtl.[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND Dodtl.[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND Dodtl.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND Dodtl.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND Dodtl.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] SalDaliveryOrder ON SalDaliveryOrder.[DeliveryOrderID] = Dodtl.[DOHeaderID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[CompanyID] = Dodtl.[CompanyID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[PeriodID] = Dodtl.[PeriodID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SalDaliveryOrder.[Status] = 1
left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity),0) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) Reversed on Reversed.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and Reversed .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and Reversed .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and Reversed .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID]
Where SalDaliveryOrder.DeliveryOrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderID and SalDaliveryOrder.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].CompanyID and Dodtl.DODetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID And [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Status=1
Group By SourceCode,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID--,Reversed.ReversedQuantity ) as RemainingQty), [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity) RemainingQty, '' [Action],INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID, [RackName] ,SET_Location.[LocationID],[LocationName],[SAL_OrderDetail].Inclusive ,Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID,Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo ,INV_LoadingPointDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity FROM [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] inner join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader on Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DOHeaderID and Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.companyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].companyID and Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].PeriodID INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID]
inner join SAL_Contractdetail on SAL_Contractdetail.ContractID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .ContractHeaderID and SAL_Contractdetail.ContractDetailID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .ContractDetailID and SAL_Contractdetail.CompanyID = [SAL_OrderDetail] .CompanyID and SAL_Contractdetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --AND Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 left join Set_ItemCatalog on Set_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LocationID WHERE [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = @DeliveryOrderID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 and INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo = @GrossWtDoc and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {2} and ISNULL( ( -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - (ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) - isnull(sum(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity),0)) -- Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(TransactionQuantity, 0))) Select ISNULL(DODetail.[Quantity], 0) - 0 from Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DODetail Inner Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader On Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = DODetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = DODetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = DODetail.DOHeaderID Left JOIN INV_StocKTransactionDetail ON DODetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND DODetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND DODetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ,sum(ReversedQuantity) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID],SourceDocumentTypeID ) SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID

SELECT Distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) AS Amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, isnull(inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode,'')+''+ INV_Item.Description as Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit, Set_Batch.Description as Batch, Sum(ISNULL(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, IsNull(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0)) * (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)), 0)) AS TotalAmount, '' [Action], SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID as DODocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, set_location.LocationName, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID], set_rack.RackName, IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive, 0) As IsInclusive,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks, 0 as RemainingQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoOfPackages ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID When 1 then 'Medium' When 2 then 'Bold' When 3 then 'Fine' else '' end AS GrainSizeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID When 1 then 'With_InnerLiner' When 2 then 'Without_InnerLiner' else '' end AS PackingName ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --and Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 --INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] left JOIN [INV_Item] dispatchItem ON dispatchItem.[ItemID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 left join set_location on set_location.LocationID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[LocationID] left join set_rack on set_rack.rackID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID] inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID] = @DispatchID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 Group By SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID, inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, Set_Batch.Description, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity, SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, SAL_OrderDetail.BaseAmount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, set_location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, set_rack.RackName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoOfPackages ,GrainSizeID,PackTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.DispatchItemID,dispatchItem.Description,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID ORDER BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID]
