Select SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo AS DeliveryChallanNo , SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Site as AddressLine1, -- AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.ContactPersonName as Collector ,AR_SET_Customer.CollectorContactNumber, -- SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as [S.NO], Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, --(Select SUM(TAB.QTY) from -- (select isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0) * -1 as QTY -- from Inv_StockTransactionHeader STH -- Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail STD On STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID And STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID And STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID -- Where STH.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And STH.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And STH.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo -- And STH.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND STD.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID -- ) as TAB -- )as LiftedQty, ISNULL(SUM(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0) *-1 as LiftedQty,
--INV_Item.[Description], SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,SAL_ContractHeader.Remarks
,(Select Top 1 INV_Item.Description from INV_Item as INV_Iteminner Inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] ) as Description
From SAL_DispatchHeader
Inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID
left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID
left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID
left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID -- inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] --and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID --and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
--INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID
left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractDetail ON SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
Where SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = @DispatchNo and SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Site , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPersonName ,AR_SET_Customer.CollectorContactNumber, Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, INV_Item.[Description], SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,SAL_ContractHeader.Remarks ,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID, Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID

INNER JOIN INV_FirstWeight ON INV_FirstWeight.FirstWeightID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo AND INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID AND INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID AND INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID AND INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_FirstWeight.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SAL_GateIn ON SAL_GateIn.GateInID = INV_FirstWeight.GateINID AND SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType AND SAL_GateIn.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID AND SAL_GateIn.PeriodID = INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID AND SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_GateIn.Status = 1
left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID
left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID
left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] --and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID --and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
--left JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID
left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyId AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractDetail ON SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
Where SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = @DispatchNo and SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_Dispatch_NoteFor_SKU
data.value:
SELECT Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber--, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo ,Case SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo When NULL Then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo Else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo End As ContractNo ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_OrderHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber ,brooker.CustomerName as BrokerName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = dbo.SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @currentfiscalid
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID --INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_LoadingPointDetail.[ItemID] inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer brooker ON brooker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND brooker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID=Transp.PeriodID and Transp.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate Inner Join SAL_ContractHeader On SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID And SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_GetDateWiseLiftingReport_PS
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,case SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DeliveryOrderStatus ,[SET_Batch].[Description] as Batch ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchID] ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DispatchStatus ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CompanyID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[PeriodID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DocumentTypeID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[VehicleNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[BiltyNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII --,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.[Quantity] ,(case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = 178 then (SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] * -1) else SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] end) as TotalAmount ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[GrossWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TareWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[NetWeight] ,[INV_Item].[Description] --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1, 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure Else IsNull(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure end as Quantity
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity * -1 Else abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) end as Bags
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
inner join [SET_Batch] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[Season] = [SET_Batch].[BatchID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_Batch].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_Batch].[PeriodID] AND [SET_Batch].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER join set_documenttype on set_documenttype.DocumentTypeID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID AND set_documenttype.CompanyID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.NetWeight,DispatchNo --,case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as CustomerName ,ar_set_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName [TransporterName], case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber) else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as [CNIC] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate [DispatchTime],(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) Quantity ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress --, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII end as CustomerAddress ,SET_Business.BusinessName as BusinessName, SET_Business.AddressLine2,Set_Batch.Description as Batch, tbl_Broker.CustomerName as BrokerName, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII as DriverName, --SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber, format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverContactNumber, '-',''),0)),'0###-#######') as DriverContactNumber, --SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII as DriverCNIC, format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') as DriverCNIC ,SET_VehicleType.TypeName, isnull(SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII,'') as DriverAddress, ISNULL(SAL_DispatchHeader.UpdatedByValue,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,SAL_Token.DriverName AS TokenDriverName ,format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace(SAL_Token.CNICNO, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') as TokenDriverCNICNo ,format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace(SAL_Token.DriverMobileNo, '-',''),0)),'0###-#######') as TokenDriverMobileNo
from SAL_DispatchHeader
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID --and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID
inner join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Left Join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker ON tbl_Broker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID And tbl_Broker.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader On SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_Token ON SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenTypeID And SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo And SAL_Token.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And SAL_Token.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And SAL_Token.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And SAL_Token.Status = 1
Inner Join SAL_SecondWeight On SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenNo = SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo And SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenType = SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID And SAL_SecondWeight.CompanyID = SAL_Token.CompanyID And SAL_SecondWeight.PeriodID = SAL_Token.PeriodID And SAL_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_Token.CurrentFiscalID And SAL_SecondWeight.Status = 1
Left join SET_VehicleType On SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_Token.VehicleTypeID AND SET_VehicleType.Status = 1
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and CategoryID = @CategoryID {0}
Group By GatePassNo,INV_Item.Description, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo,DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.Dispatchdate,sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine2 ,Set_Batch.Description, tbl_Broker.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverContactNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.NetWeight ,SET_VehicleType.TypeName,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerAddressII,SAL_DispatchHeader.UpdatedByValue,SAL_DispatchHeader.CreatedByValue ,SAL_Token.DriverName, SAL_Token.CNICNO, SAL_Token.DriverMobileNo order by SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID

data.name: Query_VehicleWiseWeighment_ReportforSSML
data.value:
select '1' as abc, DispatchDate, DocumentNo,DocumentTypeID,VehicleNo,TareWeight,GrossWeight,NetWeight,sum(Quantity) as Quantity,TokenNo,max(BiltyNo)as BiltyNo,max(UnitWeight)as UnitWeight from ( Select distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DocumentNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, --(Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then -- INV_FirstWeight.TareWeight * -1 -- else -- INV_FirstWeight.TareWeight -- end -- ) as TareWeight, -- (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then -- INV_SecondWeight.GrossWeight * -1 -- else -- INV_SecondWeight.GrossWeight -- end -- ) as GrossWeight, -- (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then -- (INV_SecondWeight.GrossWeight - INV_FirstWeight.TareWeight) * -1 -- else -- INV_SecondWeight.GrossWeight - INV_FirstWeight.TareWeight -- end -- ) as NetWeight, [SAL_DispatchHeader].TareWeight,[SAL_DispatchHeader].GrossWeight,[SAL_DispatchHeader].NetWeight, (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then (ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))) * -1 else (ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))) end ) as Quantity,
SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo ,(SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo)as BiltyNo , (INV_Item.UnitVolume) as UnitWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID FROM [INV_SecondWeight] Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [INV_SecondWeight].DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = [INV_SecondWeight].CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo = [INV_SecondWeight].LoadingPointNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = [INV_SecondWeight].CurrentFiscalID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID = [INV_SecondWeight].LPDocType Inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID and INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID = INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.fiscalID = INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.Itemid = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Itemid
--INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID -- AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID -- AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID -- AND SET_DocumentType.status = 1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
-- inner join SAL_SecondWeight on SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo --and SAL_SecondWeight.SalTokenType = SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenTypeID --and SAL_SecondWeight.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --and SAL_SecondWeight.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --and SAL_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND [INV_SecondWeight].[Status] = 1 {0} --group by SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight, SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight -- ,SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight- SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TokenNo )as tab group by VehicleNo,TareWeight,GrossWeight,NetWeight,TokenNo,DocumentTypeID,DocumentNo,tab.DispatchDate
Order by tab.DispatchDate asc

data.name: Query_GetDateWiseLiftingTransporterReport
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID, [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,case SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DeliveryOrderStatus ,[SET_Batch].[Description] as Batch ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchID] ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DispatchStatus ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CompanyID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[PeriodID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DocumentTypeID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[VehicleNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[BiltyNo] --,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.[Quantity] ,(case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = 178 then (SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] * -1) else SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] end) as TotalAmount ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[GrossWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TareWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[NetWeight] ,[INV_Item].[Description] --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1, 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure Else IsNull(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure end as Quantity
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity * -1 Else abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) end as Bags ,Transporter.CustomerName as TransporterName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left join SAL_Token on SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo = [SAL_DispatchHeader].TokenNo And SAL_Token.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID And SAL_Token.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID AND SAL_Token.CurrentFiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID
left join [AR_SET_Customer] as Transporter ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].TransporterID = Transporter.[CustomerID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = Transporter.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = Transporter.[PeriodID] AND Transporter.[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
inner join [SET_Batch] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[Season] = [SET_Batch].[BatchID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_Batch].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_Batch].[PeriodID] AND [SET_Batch].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER join set_documenttype on set_documenttype.DocumentTypeID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID AND set_documenttype.CompanyID= [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_Select_By_CustomerID_For_FA_Dispatch
data.value:
Select * From ( SELECT Distinct StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate], '' as referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,
(select abs(Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity])) as qty from [INV_StockTransactionDetail] where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 )as StockQuantity, SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) as InvoicedQuantity ,Cast(((select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_stockTransactionDetail Where INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_stockTransactionDetail.StocktransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID Group By INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID)) AS Decimal(18,0))TransactionQty ,( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID )as ReverseQty
FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader ON StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND StockHeader.[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND StockHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND ([SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 {0} {1}
Group By SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, StockHeader.[StockTransactionID], Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID HAVING Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) >= SUM(ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], 0)) )tab Where (tab.TransactionQty - isnull(ReverseQty,0)) >= InvoicedQuantity Order By tab.[DispatchDate]

data.name: Query_Dispatch_NoteFor_RaniPur
data.value:
SELECT Cast( SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as Date) DispatchDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SET_Location.LocationName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, SET_City.CityName, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber--, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo ,Case SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo When NULL Then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo Else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo End As ContractNo ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (Case INV_Item.SourceTypeID When 1 then 'Imported' when 2 then 'Local' else '' end ) as Source,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AS DONumber, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity AS DOQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS DispatchQty ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus , [SET_OperatingUnit].Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,
isnull( ( SELECT DISTINCT top 1 DOD.Quantity - sum(abs(isnull(STD.TransactionQuantity,0))) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader DH INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader STH ON STH.CompanyID = DH.CompanyID AND STH.PeriodID = DH.PeriodID AND STH.DocumentTypeID = DH.DocumentTypeID AND STH.DocumentNo = DH.DispatchNo AND STH.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail STD ON STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID AND STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID AND STD.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail DOD ON DOD.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND DOD.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND DOD.DOHeaderID = STD.SourceHeaderID AND DOD.DODetailID = STD.SourceLineID AND DOD.[Status] = 1 WHERE DH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DH.[Status] = 1 AND STD.SourceCode = (Convert(int,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,0))) AND DH.DispatchNo<SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo group by DOD.Quantity )- abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity - abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS DOBalance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.TareWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo ,set_VehicleType.TypeName as VehicleName ,Transp.CustomerName as TransporterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments,DBT.Description as DetailBatch ,INV_Item.Length,INV_Item.Width,INV_Item.GSM,INV_Item.Color,SAL_OrderHeader.Season as PONo, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks as ContactPerson,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID as 'PackingBales', SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress as DriverName,(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID) as 'NoOfBales' ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,(Case Set_DocumentType.GroupID when null then '--' +' '+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) else substring(Right(DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,3),1,1)+'D' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo) end ) as DispatchNumber ,brooker.CustomerName as BrokerName FROM SAL_DispatchHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = dbo.SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @currentfiscalid
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] Inner Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] left JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] LEFT JOIN Set_Batch as DBT ON DBT.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId AND DBT.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND DBT.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID --INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID LEFT join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOheaderID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID= [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].CompanyID
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID,[INV_Item].[PrimaryUOMCode]) INNER JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer brooker ON brooker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND brooker.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID LEFT JOIN SET_City ON AR_SET_Customer.CityID = SET_City.CityID left join set_VehicleType on set_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleTypeID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Transp on Transp.[CompanyID] = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID=Transp.PeriodID and Transp.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID LEFT Join SAL_ContractHeader On SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID And SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_GetAgentWiseLiftingReport
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,case SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DeliveryOrderStatus ,[SET_Batch].[Description] as Batch ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchID] ,case SAL_DispatchHeader.statusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as DispatchStatus ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CompanyID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[PeriodID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DocumentTypeID] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[VehicleNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[BiltyNo] --,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.[Quantity] ,(case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = 178 then (SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] * -1) else SAL_DispatchHeader.[TotalAmount] end) as TotalAmount ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[GrossWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[TareWeight] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[NetWeight] ,[INV_Item].[Description] --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1, 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure Else IsNull(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) * INV_Item.UnitWeight / INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure end as Quantity
,case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity * -1 Else abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) end as Bags FROM SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[BrokerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID AND TypeCode = 4

data.name: Query_GetGatePassMBSM_TSM
data.value:
select distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, --INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ( case when INV_SET_Category.CategoryName = 'Sugar' then 'Refined Sugar' else INV_SET_Category.CategoryName end ) as CategoryName ,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, --sourcecode, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, ceiling(GrossWeight) GrossWeight, ceiling(TareWeight) TareWeight, ceiling(NetWeight)NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount --, SUM( -- ( -- Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode -- then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitVolume, 1) -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ISNULL(UnitWeight, 1) -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * 1 end --)) as Weight , -- case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName --else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName + ' A/C ' + isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName,ar_set_Customer.CustomerName) end as CustomerName
--case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else CustomerParty.CustomerName end as CustomerName
case SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'In-Process' else '' end as [Status] , DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName [TransporterName], case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber) else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end as [CNIC] , SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate [DispatchTime] --,(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) Quantity ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end as AddressLine1 ,abctype.TypeName ,max(abctype.LoadingTime)LoadingTime ,SET_Business.BusinessName as BusinessName, SET_Business.AddressLine2, INV_Item.primaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight,INV_Item.UnitVolume , case when (select count(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1) > 1 then ( ''+ convert(varchar,isnull((select min(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1),'')) + '-' + convert(varchar,isnull((select max(DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1),'')) + '' ) else GatePassNo end as GatePassNo
,STUFF( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + (case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.CustomerName else CustomerParty.CustomerName end ) + ' ' + (case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end )
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr inner join SAL_DispatchHeader dishdr on dishdr.DocumentTypeID = stkHdr .DocumentTypeID and dishdr.DispatchNo = stkHdr .DocumentNo and dishdr.FiscalID = stkHdr .FiscalID and dishdr.CompanyID = stkHdr .CompanyID
inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = dishdr.CustomerID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = dishdr.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = dishdr.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = dishdr.PeriodID
where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.status = 1 and stkHdr.StatusCode = 1
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') as CustomerName
,(select sum(abs(dtl.TransactionQuantity)) from INV_StockTransactionHeader stkHdr inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail dtl on dtl.StockTransactionID = stkHdr.StockTransactionID and dtl.CompanyID = stkHdr.CompanyID and dtl.Status = 1 where stkHdr.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and stkHdr.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and stkHdr.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and stkHdr.GrossWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and stkHdr.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and stkHdr.status = 1 and stkHdr.StatusCode = 1 ) as Quantity ,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT ', ' + Convert(Varchar,SourceCode,3) AS 'data()' from (
select ch.SourceCode from Inv_StockTransactionDetail ch
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = ch.SourceHeaderID And ch.SourceLineID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And ch.SourceCode = inv_dtl.SourceCode And ch.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And ch.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)DO group by DO.SourceCode FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) ) as DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join ar_set_Customer on ar_set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID
inner join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
left join ( Select TypeName,DOHeaderID,DODetailID,SAL_GateIn.CompanyID,Format(INV_LoadingPointHeader.CreateDate, 'hh:mm tt')LoadingTime,Quantity ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as SecondWeightID ,SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID as FiscalID ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as GrossWtNo from SAL_GateIn inner join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_GateIn.VehicleTypeID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID
) abctype on abctype.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and abctype.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and abctype.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and abctype.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.fiscalID and abctype.GrossWtNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID
inner join set_documenttype on SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = set_documenttype.documenttypeid and SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = set_documenttype.CompanyID LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and CategoryID = @CategoryID and abctype.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID {0} Group By GatePassNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.VehicleNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo, GrossWeight, TareWeight, NetWeight, DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, SAL_DispatchHeader.Dispatchdate, --sourcecode, ar_set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Transporter.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC,SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName,SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyAddress,abctype.TypeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine2 ,INV_Item.primaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight,INV_Item.UnitVolume,CustomerParty.CustomerName,abctype.Quantity,CustomerParty.AddressLine1 ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail .SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID ,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID

SELECT distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[TransporterID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleNo] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[BiltyNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[BiltyAddress],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[TotalAmount],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsInvoiceGenerated] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[GatePassNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CreatedBy],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CreateDate] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[UpdatedBy],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[UpdateDate],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CreatedByValue],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[UpdatedByValue] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[StatusCode],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsDirectDispatch],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CNIC],

,case when ar_set_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then ar_set_Customer.AddressLine1 else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end as AddressLine1, convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT '/ ' + Convert(Varchar(Max),Invoice.CustomerPoNo) AS 'data()' from (
select CustomerPoNo from SAL_ContractHeader ch inner join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail Do on Do.ContractHeaderID = ch.ContractID and Do.CompanyID = ch.CompanyID and Do.PeriodID = ch.PeriodID
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = Do.DOHeaderID And Do.DODetailID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And Do.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And Do.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)Invoice group by CustomerPoNo FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As CustomerPoNo
,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT '/ ' + Convert(Varchar,Invoice.CustomerPoDate,3) AS 'data()' from (
select CustomerPoDate from SAL_ContractHeader ch inner join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail Do on Do.ContractHeaderID = ch.ContractID and Do.CompanyID = ch.CompanyID and Do.PeriodID = ch.PeriodID
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = Do.DOHeaderID And Do.DODetailID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And Do.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And Do.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)Invoice group by CustomerPoDate FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As CustomerPoDate
,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( (SELECT ', ' + Convert(Varchar,SourceCode,3) AS 'data()' from (
select ch.SourceCode from Inv_StockTransactionDetail ch
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail inv_dtl on inv_dtl.SourceHeaderID = ch.SourceHeaderID And ch.SourceLineID = inv_dtl.SourceLineID And ch.SourceCode = inv_dtl.SourceCode And ch.CompanyID = inv_dtl.CompanyID And ch.PeriodID = inv_dtl.PeriodID where inv_dtl.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and inv_dtl.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and inv_dtl.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
)DO group by DO.SourceCode FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) ) as DeliveryOrderNo ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO as CustomerCallPO2 , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate as CustomerCallPODate2, SAL_DispatchHeader.BuyerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.BuyerCNIC FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo ANd Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Inv_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail On Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID Left Join Sal_OrderDetail On Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID Left Join Sal_OrderHeader On Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID And Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID And Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID left join AR_SET_Customer Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transporter.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Transporter.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID AND CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_City on Set_City.CityID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CityID AND SET_City.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.CompanyId and SET_Business.IsActive = 1 and SET_Business.Status = 1 left join ( Select TypeName,DOHeaderID,DODetailID,SAL_GateIn.CompanyID ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as SecondWeightID
,SAL_GateIn.DriverName as DrName,SAL_GateIn.CNICNO,SAL_GateIn.LICNo,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo as VihclNo ,SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID as FiscalID ,INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo as GrossWtNo from SAL_GateIn inner join SET_VehicleType on SET_VehicleType.VehicleTypeID = SAL_GateIn.VehicleTypeID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID
inner join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo and INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID
) abctype on abctype.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and abctype.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and abctype.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and abctype.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.fiscalID and abctype.GrossWtNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID {0}
left Join SAL_ContractHeader On SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where abctype.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID group by [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[LocationID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleTypeID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[TransporterID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID],[SAL_DispatchHeader].[CityID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[VehicleNo]
